text.description_html:
Don-Jo Steel Security Wrap-Around Door Plates CW51 - 2 1/8 Hole

Protect your doors from entry tools and tampering with this steel wrap around security door plate.

DJO-CW Features:

  • Steel 22 (.032 gauge) construction
  • Assorted finishes available
  • Built-in stainless steel threaded insert for tube latch
  • Long lasting and secure mounting of latch and bolt
  • Heavy duty stainless steel trim screws
  • Permanent holding power eliminates loosening of latch mounting screws

DJO-CW Specs:

  • DJO-51CW - Backset 2 3/8", Door thickness 1 3/8", Plate - 4" x 4-1/2"
  • DJO-61CW - Backset 2 3/8", Door thickness 1 3/8", Plate - 4" x 4-1/2"
  • DJO-71CW - Backset 2 3/4", Door thickness 1 3/8", Plate - 4-1/4" x 4-1/2"
  • DJO-81CW - Backset 2 3/4", Door thickness 1 3/8", Plate - 4-1/4" x 4-1/2"

All of these are for a door with a 2-1/8 hole and cylindrical door locks.
